caption:
A missed call still converts.

The move you make right after it decides whether it does.

Verse.ai studied 10 million SMS conversations. Calling alone gets answered 25% of the time. Texting alone gets answered 50% of the time.

Text first, then call, and the answer rate climbs to 92%. The text gets a reply. The reply makes the call expected instead of a surprise.

Next missed call: send a text within minutes, then dial. Skip the blind redial.
